ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65:0.35 ratio of high-intensity (white/off-white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central lobe regions; thick, irregular black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips; large, dark bifurcated wedge extending from the peduncle transition into the central fluke area; scattered low-intensity mottling within high-intensity fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree internal angle and a significant vertical depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration; distinct jagged peaks and deep valleys visible along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge, particularly prominent on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature along the trailing edge, sweeping upwards and outwards towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast dark cluster on the distal tip of the left lobe, indicating dense colonization or localized scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, protruding cluster of organisms (likely barnacles) on the left fluke tip; significant irregular pigmentation and possible scarring on the extreme right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Trailing organic material or debris attached to the left fluke tip; distinct yellowish-tinted pixel regions near the interior base of the right lobe.
